impact: Tournament reruns are conditional on one frozen field per scenario; no regime-level inference.
mitigation: Three deliberately different fields; results stated per field.
statement: Results hold in these controlled fields; no claim about classes of fields.

impact: Rule-based policy families without within-match opponent modelling may under- or over-state luck vs skill in real bot fields.
mitigation: Diversity audit (8 archetypes; style_diverse has no near-duplicates).
statement: Agents are synthetic stateless policies; transfer to adaptive agents is untested.

impact: Built from the strongest defensible six plus the 54 weakest pool bots; not a natural field.
mitigation: One-shot independent validation (P = 0.998) and an independent field-relative reference.
statement: Use "engineered separated control"; never call it representative.

impact: Reliability had not plateaued at 40 rounds; how much more rounds would help is unknown.
mitigation: Horizon fixed at 5 to 40 by preregistration; 60/80/120 explicitly not run.

impact: Frozen schedules come from adaptive trajectories; replay adds fresh randomness; J = 1.
mitigation: Paired by source tournament; termed a counterfactual from the start.
statement: "source-schedule counterfactual"; not a causal effect of adaptation.

impact: Duplicate packages also change rounds or match length; work ratios not exactly 1.
mitigation: Reported scheduled and played work ratios; mechanism given only as a diagnostic.
statement: "operational package comparison"; no isolated duplication effect.

impact: Reference top 6 below the three leaders is unsettled; a bot outside the designed sets has P(reference top 6) 0.208 at the 500-round ceiling.
mitigation: Propagated reference uncertainty, clear-error counts, and agreement with mu_swiss.
statement: Treat the crowded-cutoff reference boundary as uncertain; rely on rerun metrics and clear errors there.

impact: Decided after matrix data were seen; under the broad reading 4 of 18 cells would have extended 50 to 100.
mitigation: Decision recorded before any extension ran; broad-reading verdicts reported as a sensitivity.
statement: Disclose in methods with the sensitivity verdict.

impact: Public-2026-style research semantics are not exact historical production settings, nor any future FullHouse rules.
mitigation: Semantics fixed and documented; historical provenance separated from the research baseline.
statement: No statement about historical results or future competition formats.

impact: Wall-clock and CPU ratios are distorted by machine throttling and sleep.
mitigation: Work measured in scheduled and played hands.
statement: Report hands; CPU ratios indicative only.
